name: Suki
source: Suki is Elena Sanchez's younger sister. She wastes no time in teasing her sister about the latter's previously-lackluster love life right in front of Alex. On top of that, she pretends to be having labor contractions when they first meet, and bases her opinion of him on how the player chooses to react.
